spec_case: issue #479's own test plan: an invalid pattern, error_compare: location, location_pattern on the 'regex: invalid pattern: ' prefix
description: An unterminated group fails to compile on both engines with the 'regex: invalid pattern: ' prefix -- CPython's own re.error text after it is never going to match fancy-regex's, so only the prefix (both failing at the same place) is compared, never byte for byte.
